title: Serkan Pre-Check — IBKR Real vs Serkan Reference Cost Comparison
assumption: Serkan likely uses €0.85/side = €1.70/roundturn uniform for all instruments. We use IBKR all-in confirmed costs.

perInstrumentComparison.note: IBKR more expensive — high exchange fee on CME FX
IBKR CHEAPER than Serkan — very low EUREX fee for FDXS micro
IBKR more expensive — COMEX micro fee

fourComponentPortfolio_E6MonLong.keyFinding: IBKR real costs for this specific portfolio are CHEAPER than Serkan uniform estimate. FDXS advantage (€0.76/rt vs €1.70/rt) on 2,936 combined DAX trades outweighs 6E premium (€4.10 vs €1.70) on only 415 trades.
fourComponentPortfolio_E6MonLong.note: This finding is specific to portfolios dominated by EUREX/FDXS trading. A portfolio dominated by 6E, SB, or CC would show IBKR being more expensive.

slippageModel.note: Slippage not included in IBKR confirmed costs above. Estimates only.

whereSerkanMightDiffer.detail: Serkan may use fixed per-contract vs IBKR tiered — at low volume, tiered is typically more expensive
